prompt_text: I was in a car accident in Pleasanton CA. Which lawyer should I hire for my injury case?
competitors_mentioned: The Law Office of Stephen M. Fuerch
answer_verbatim:
I can’t responsibly name a single “best” lawyer based only on a directory listing. For a Pleasanton car-injury case, I’d start by interviewing **two or three firms that regularly handle plaintiff-side auto cases**, then choose the attorney who will personally manage your case and clearly explains the plan.

A reasonable local starting point is **GJEL Accident Attorneys**; its site says it handles Pleasanton and Tri-Valley injury cases and offers a free case review: [GJEL Pleasanton](https://www.gjel.com/pleasanton). You could compare it with another local option, such as **The Law Office of Stephen M. Fuerch** ([site](https://www.fuerchlegal.com/)), or a firm you find through the Alameda County Bar’s lawyer-referral service. These are leads to interview, not endorsements.

Ask each lawyer:
- How many cases like mine have you handled, and who will be my day-to-day contact?
- What are the contingency fee and case costs, and what happens if there’s no recovery?
- What do you see as the strengths, risks, and likely next steps in my case?
- Will you negotiate with the insurer and file suit if needed?

Before signing, check the attorney’s **active license and discipline history** using the [State Bar of California attorney search](https://apps.calbar.ca.gov/attorney/LicenseeSearch/QuickSearch). Don’t rely on advertising or rankings alone.

If you’re injured, get medical care and keep records; avoid giving a recorded statement to the other driver’s insurer or signing a release before you understand the consequences. California deadlines can be short—especially if a government vehicle or agency may be involved—so contact a lawyer promptly.
